hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a custom-curve AMM hook that handles swaps entirely in beforeSwap by depositing input tokens into Euler Finance vaults and withdrawing output tokens from them, enforcing a proprietary curve invariant (CurveLib). It blocks concentrated liquidity positions (beforeAddLiquidity reverts) and donations (beforeDonate reverts) to prevent misuse of the non-CLAMM pool.
